finding.claim: cache.ts subscribe returns an unsubscribe that splices without checking indexOf; calling it twice or after removal splices index -1 and removes the wrong callback.
finding.title: Unsubscribe without index check removes wrong subscriber

verifier.reason: The unsubscribe at cache.ts:59 is `return () => subs.splice(subs.indexOf(callback), 1)` with no -1 guard, so a second call yields indexOf -1 and splice(-1, 1) removes the last remaining subscriber.

finding.claim: INITIAL_CACHE is module-level and only ever written, never cleared or scoped to a cache provider; once a key is stored the server snapshot getter returns that stale initial value forever across providers and remounts.
finding.title: Module-level INITIAL_CACHE never reset shares stale snapshot

verifier.reason: Confirmed from helper.ts:6 where INITIAL_CACHE is a non-exported module-level Record, helper.ts:33-34 where it is only conditionally written, and helper.ts:46 where the server snapshot getter returns it by key alone without reference to the cache argument; the full 56-line helper.ts contains no delete, reassignment, or clearing, and it cannot be cleared externally since it is not exported.

finding.claim: After startRevalidate the code unconditionally clears _c, so a second concurrent optimistic mutation that set a new _c backup has its backup wiped by the first mutation's completion, breaking rollback.

evidence.snippet:
// When we set optimistic data, backup the current committedData data in `_c`.
      set({ data: optimisticData, _c: committedData })

finding.title: Unconditional _c clear races with concurrent optimistic mutations

finding.claim: Cache init is stored in a ref only on first provider and the layout effect has empty deps; a provider that appears after mount never gets initProvider called nor unmount cleanup, and a changed provider is ignored while old listeners leak.
finding.title: Late or changed provider misses init and cleanup

verifier.reason: The claim that a late provider never gets initProvider called is false: config-context.ts:45 re-evaluates the provider guard on every render and calls initCache when a provider first appears, and cache.ts:123 calls initProvider() inside initCache itself, so initialization occurs during that render even though the empty-deps effect will not re-run.
